reasons: Section 18.1 matches the preferred position exactly: CGL USD 1M/2M, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O USD 2M, and cyber/privacy USD 5M, at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year.

Section 18.2 supplies the certificates-on-request requirement and adds customer-favourable terms (insurer quality, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, no cap on liability), so the clause meets or exceeds the playbook.
Compliant status is correctly handled: no redline or comment proposed, and the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.
Deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present, consistent with the compliant classification.
